newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open down 0.05 to 0.10.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open down 0.05 to 0.10.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open 0.05 to 0.10 cent weaker Wednesday, dealers said.
Speculative rolling of front month July ahead of its expiry on June 30 is expected to pressure prices. Support was seen from 11.20 to 11.00 cents a lb.
Scale-down buying by the trade could slow losses, dealers said.
Tuesday, July closed 0.08 cent lower at 11.37 cents after trading from 11.41 to 11.32 cents. October settled down 0.06 at 11.25, while the outer months went out 0.04 to 0.07 weaker.

LIFFE white sugar futures were trading lower on Wednesday amid selling by commission houses, but prices found support from the trade. At 0845 EDT/1245 GMT, spot August stood $0.30 lower at $322.00. The back months were trading $0.60 to $1.00 lower.
